d.seg: ब्लाउज कर लो कपड़ा नहीं अच्छा है देखूँगा
d.tr: Open your blouse, the clothes are not good, I will see.
d.ctx: The user asks the expert to show her body by opening her clothes. The expert responds by asking about her dinner.
d.j: The user is explicitly asking the expert to show her body by opening her clothes, which matches the strong case for Explicit-Flirting.

d.seg: हम व्हाट्सएप वगैरह पे भी वो करते हैं
d.tr: We also do that on WhatsApp etc.
d.ctx: The user asks to see more, and the expert suggests moving the conversation to WhatsApp.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp), which matches the strong case for PlatformMove.

d.seg: दियो आपके व्हाट्सएप आपके व्हाट्सएप दियो
d.tr: Give your WhatsApp, give your WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The user asks for the expert's WhatsApp number.
d.j: The user is asking for the expert's WhatsApp contact information, which matches the strong case for PlatformMove.

d.seg: व्हाट्सएप पे पेमेंट आना पड़ेगा आपको
d.tr: You will have to pay on WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The expert demands payment on WhatsApp to continue the interaction.
d.j: The expert is linking a payment to a service outside the app, which matches the strong case for SuspiciousActivity.

d.seg: चार सौ पाँच सौ जो आपको डालना है आप डाल सकते हो
d.tr: Four hundred, five hundred, whatever you want to put, you can put.
d.ctx: The expert is specifying a price for the service.
d.j: The expert is naming a price for a service, which matches the strong case for SuspiciousActivity.

d.seg: कॉल में पेमेंट डालोगे तभी कर पाएंगे तभी
d.tr: Only if you put payment in the call will we be able to do it, only then.
d.ctx: The expert reiterates that payment is required to continue the interaction.
d.j: The expert is demanding payment for a service, which matches the strong case for SuspiciousActivity.
